name: Wilson Lab
summary: Engineering modular protein therapeutics against oncogenic proteins
title: Undergraduate Researcher
org: Wilson Laboratory, Department of Microbiology, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
bullets: Engineering a class of novel modular protein therapeutics to efficiently translocate and selectively degrade oncogenic intracellular proteins.
Performed computational structure and solubility analysis using AlphaFold3, ColabFold, CamSol, GROMACS, and PyMOL to diagnose and resolve protein insolubility in chimeric constructs.
Carried out recombinant expression and purification by nickel affinity and ion exchange chromatography, with construct verification by Sanger sequencing and Western blot.
Functionally characterizing multiple homologs of a bacterial AB-type toxin to determine dimerization.
Developing modular immunotoxins to treat canine B cell lymphoma.
Mentoring seven undergraduate researchers; managing laboratory supplies and reagents and coordinating day-to-day laboratory operations.
